paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Rav Huna said in Rav’s name. Jerusalem Talmud, first chapter of Eruvin: Abba bar Huna. At the end of the first chapter of Shekalim: Rabbi Ba in Abba bar Rav Chuna’s name. Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Shor Shenagach Arba'ah Vachamishah, halakhah 5: Abba bar Rav Huna; first chapter of Eruvin and chapter 3: Abba bar Rav Chuna. Chapter Haddar: bar Chuna in Rabbi Yochanan’s name; beginning of Hazorek: in Rav’s name. (See below, Rabbah bar Rav Huna; perhaps they are one.)
